turns.question: How much did bookings grow in the week of 14 September 2026 compared with the previous week?
turns.answer: Bookings grew by 27.3 % in the week of 14 September 2026 (Monday 14 to Sunday 20 September) compared with the previous week (a week-over-week growth of 0.27, where 0.10 is 10 % more). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
